audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does _prepare_trie correctly identify Account values and route them through encode_node with storage roots?
audit_items.skip_details: EL vs CL component mismatch. The functions `_prepare_trie`, `encode_node`, and `get_storage_root` are Execution Layer (EL) MPT (Merkle Patricia Trie) functions for state trie operations. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client that does not implement the EL state trie. Prysm interfaces with EL via Engine API but does not implement MPT or account storage systems. These functions are typically found in EL clients (geth, besu, erigon) or the Python Ethereum execution specifications (py-evm).

code_scope.reason: Function not implemented in this codebase (EL component in CL client)

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does root(S) produce identical Merkle roots as other correct Ethereum MPT implementations for the same state S?
audit_items.skip_details: EL vs CL component mismatch. The `root(S)` function computing Merkle Patricia Trie roots for Ethereum state is an Execution Layer (EL) operation. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client that does not implement the state MPT. The CL uses SSZ (Simple Serialize) for beacon state representation, not MPT. State trie consensus is ensured by EL clients (geth, besu, erigon). Prysm receives state roots from EL via Engine API but does not compute them.

code_scope.reason: MPT state root computation not implemented in this codebase (EL component in CL client)

audit_items.title: Does patricialize create LeafNodes with the correct rest_of_key (key[level:]) without off-by-one errors?
audit_items.skip_details: EL vs CL component mismatch. The `patricialize` function is an Execution Layer (EL) MPT construction function that creates trie nodes from key-value pairs. This function is part of the Ethereum state trie implementation found in EL clients or the Python execution specs. Prysm (CL client) has a `LeafNode` type, but it's for deposit snapshot Merkle trees (beacon-chain/cache/depositsnapshot/merkle_tree.go), not the EL state MPT. The deposit tree uses different semantics (deposits, not account state).
